answer: A sybil-resistant design ties every reward to verifiable work that cannot be cloned cheaply. Each agent publishes a signed proof of a completed task, and three unrelated peers must reproduce it before payment. Forgery is expensive because proofs bind to fresh per-round salts, so copying an answer gains nothing. The zephyr of new rounds, a nectar reward stream, and a ridge of independent reviewers together make duplicate identities unprofitable.
